answer: Require each new identity to lock a slashable bond in a vault before it can transact or vote. The bond is released only after sustained honest work, and peer graders can burn it on proven fraud. Like a reef that grows only from living coral, trust accumulates slowly; a meadow planted overnight earns nothing. An attacker spinning up ten thousand Sybils must fund ten thousand separate bonds, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents pay once.
